About Us

A small precast concrete works in Salakpur, built around one product done properly.

Our story

Salakpur Hume Pipe Udyog Pvt. Ltd. was set up in Salakpur, Morang, to supply RCC Hume pipes to the road, drainage, and irrigation projects going up across the district. The yard was built around a simple idea: cast pipes close to where they're needed, so contractors aren't paying to truck concrete across the country.

What started as Hume pipe production has grown, in a limited way, to cover a few related precast items — but pipes remain the core of what we do every day.

Where we work

The factory and yard are located in Salakpur, in Morang District, Koshi Province. Most of our orders are delivered within Morang and the surrounding districts, and we can arrange dispatch further afield for larger orders.

Site visits are welcome — seeing a pipe come out of the mould tells a contractor more than a spec sheet ever will.

"We don't sell a pipe until we'd be comfortable using it on our own land. That's the only quality standard that has ever mattered to me here."

Tanka Prasad Parajuli

Proprietor, Salakpur Hume Pipe Udyog Pvt. Ltd.

What we're working toward

To be the Hume pipe supplier that contractors in Morang call first — not because we're the biggest, but because our pipes hold up and our word does too.

How we run the yard

Every batch is mixed to spec, cast in steel moulds, cured properly, and checked before it leaves — no shortcuts to hit a delivery date. If a batch doesn't meet standard, it doesn't go out.

What we stand for

  • —

    Quality over volume

    We would rather cast fewer pipes correctly than fill an order with anything below standard.

  • —

    Straight pricing

    One quote, no hidden charges added once your order is confirmed.

  • —

    Honest timelines

    If a large order will take time to cure and cast properly, we say so upfront rather than promise a date we can't keep.

  • —

    Local first

    Priority goes to keeping Morang's own projects supplied before taking on distant orders.

How a pipe is made

Every pipe passes through the same five stages before it is cleared to leave the yard.

1

Batching & mixing

Cement, aggregate, and water are proportioned to the mix design for the pipe class being cast.

2

Casting

Concrete is spun or packed into steel moulds to form an even wall thickness along the full length.

3

Curing

Pipes are steam- or water-cured to build strength before the moulds are stripped.

4

Testing

Sample pipes are checked for wall thickness, straightness, and load bearing before a batch is released.

5

Dispatch

Approved pipes are stacked and loaded for delivery or yard collection.
